title: Add `podman manifest list` command
body:
### Feature request description

The `podman manifest` suite of commands can create manifests, remove them, check if they exist, inspect them - but not list them. Yes, you can find them in `podman images` - but why don't we have a command to list just manifest lists, not all images on the system?

### Suggest potential solution

Add a new command, `podman manifest list`, to show all manifests on the system.

### Have you considered any alternatives?

Just using `podman images` (works, but confusing that `manifest list` doesn't exist)

### Additional context

Should probably have an alias to `podman manifest ls`
